label: Rules said twice
means: Rule sentences that appear in more than one always-loaded or rule file.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a rule said in two always-loaded files costs its tokens twice on every call and drifts when one copy changes
source: sentences of eight or more words, markdown and case ignored, in the managed CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/rules/*.md, the repo CLAUDE.md and the memory index; detail is the files that share them

params.comment: Each setting has a default (simplicity.mjs): project_match (the repo's own project folder), managed_claude_md (the platform's managed policy CLAUDE.md), code_os_checkout (the Git Crafter checkout this collector runs from), sync_entry (user-claude). not_living: doc paths that record the past on purpose. stale_days: how old a figure's read date may be. doc_set, doc_set_left_out ([{ glob }]) and skip_dirs: the living docs, used when the engine does not pass docs.json's. projects_dir: where Claude Code keeps session transcripts; a ~/ path is under home, an absolute one is itself, any other is under the repo root.

label: Broken references in rules and memory
means: Files named in a rule, a CLAUDE.md or a memory note that no longer exist.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a reference to a file that is gone sends Claude looking for it
source: paths in code spans and markdown links, resolved from home, the naming file's folder, the repo and the Git Crafter checkout; living docs are docs.dead_paths on the Docs tab

label: Installed copies that differ from source
means: Installed rules and guards that no longer match their source in Git Crafter.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: an installed copy that differs from its source runs rules nobody reviewed
source: the Git Crafter checkout this collector runs from (params.code_os_checkout overrides): its sync tool, tools/code_os_sync.py or tools/claude_os_sync.py, status params.sync_entry (default user-claude); every file not in-sync; state, read now

label: Figures with no recent read date
means: Numbers in living docs whose sentence has no read date, or one older than a month.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a figure is attributed or labeled a goal (Git Crafter rules/writing-and-gates.md); one with no read date cannot be checked; near band: template default
source: the Docs tab's doc set (params.doc_set on quality/targets/docs.json) less params.not_living; a percent, money, a comma-grouped number or a number with a unit, outside code, without a YYYY-MM-DD within params.stale_days (default 30) in its sentence or table row

label: Memory notes naming what is gone
means: Memory notes that name a path or a command flag that no longer exists.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a memory note naming a path or flag that is gone teaches a session something false
source: memory notes, not the index: paths as in simplicity.broken_refs, and --flags in code spans that git grep finds in neither the repo nor the Git Crafter checkout
